events.title: 아스널's double hopes ended when they lost 1–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the FA Cup semi-final at Villa Park .
Argentine doctors report that soccer superstar 디에고 마라도나 has suffered a major heart attack in Buenos Aires and is in a hospital in intensive care . (news.com.au)
아스널 F.C. wins the English football league title for the 13th time.

아스널 clinched the Premier League title – and were still unbeaten – after a 2–2 draw with 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane . 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 had their promotion from Division One confirmed. The play-off places were still being contested between seven clubs: 선덜랜드, 입스위치 타운, 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 위건 애슬레틱, 셰필드 유나이티드, Reading and 크리스털 팰리스, who had climbed from 19th to 7th since the appointment of Iain Dowie as manager four months previously.
FA Premier League – 아스널 clinch the Premier League title, their second in three years, with four games still to play.
San Marino record their first ever win, a 1–0 victory over Liechtenstein in a friendly.

아스널 finished April as Premier League champions while 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 fought closely for second place. 리버풀 and 애스턴 빌라 completed the top five, though the seven teams below them still stood a chance of a top-five finish and European qualification. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 레스터 시티 needed a miracle to avoid relegation, and Leeds were still giving most of the rest of the bottom ten a run for their money.
